input.feature_ticket: Add a new REST API endpoint for user profile updates with validation

Implement JWT-based authentication system:
- Login endpoint with email/password

- Refresh token mechanism
- Logout endpoint

- Add roles table (id, name, permissions)
- Add user_roles junction table
- Update users table with role_id foreign key
- Include rollback migration

Build a reusable DataTable component in React:
- Support pagination
- Column sorting
- Search/filter functionality
- Row selection
- Export to CSV

- Unit tests with Jest

- Issue: WebSocket connections not properly closed
- Location: src/services/websocket.ts
- Expected: Connections should close on component unmount
- Add cleanup logic and tests

Add comprehensive unit tests for UserService:
- Test user creation with valid/invalid data
- Test user authentication flow
- Test password hashing
- Test user update and deletion
- Mock database calls
- Achieve 90%+ code coverage

Create API documentation for payment endpoints:
- Document all payment-related endpoints
- Include request/response examples

- Use OpenAPI/Swagger format

Optimize database queries in reporting module:
- Identify slow queries (>1s execution time)
- Add appropriate indexes
- Implement query result caching
- Add database query logging
- Include performance benchmarks
